provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Sylvavéryn is centered at 8.066809, -86.299300 under Theocracy, with 103,614,000 people across 10 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Sylvavéryn occupies 9,634,777.67 sq mi / 24,953,959.60 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 4.892301% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Farming, Partial forest and Beach and grass with water define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Farming, Partial forest, Beach and grass with water and Treetops - treehouses. Population density is 4.152 people/sq km / 10.754 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Dwarven and Gnomish Kin, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin, Harengon, Centaur, Giff, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Freeblade Veil, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Iskareth, Asethyr, Thalunesh, Marduthor, Sigrananna, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 8 recorded four-province geography group links, including 7 cross-transportation-group links. These links place it inside overlapping regional corridors rather than one isolated block, allowing border-adjacent transit, faction influence, and cultural spillover to breathe across group lines.

npcs.name: Cito Vinefriend
npcs.description: Cito Vinefriend is a Deorbasun beast-tender raised more by wild guardians than polite society, and he trusts claws, vines, and honest growls more than contracts. At the Sylthea Guild Desk, he protects animals, children, overgrown ruins, and strange found-family bonds for the Nefaric Veil, especially when outsiders see only beasts or resources. Cito is simple in speech but not in feeling, and threatening his family is the fastest way to learn how gentle strength becomes feral.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Sylthéa is a Village in Sylvavéryn, under Theocracy, with low danger, Partial forest, Farming, Marshes and swamps terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Deorbasun reads through the Deorbasun entry of the race compendium, within Miscellaneous and Hard-to-Classify Races, marked by Nephthysra. Majestic Beast-Souled Guardians of Instinct, Honor, and Mystical Territory. Table cues: ancestral instincts, homeland pressure, and local reputation; starting tendency Altruistic - Lawful - Neutral - Honorable.
rumors: Cito Vinefriend knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Nebday.
Cito Vinefriend has a contact in Maelvéra who will deny everything.
plotHooks: Cito Vinefriend asks the party to protect a household member without revealing why.
A rival faction offers proof that Cito Vinefriend's public story is incomplete.

npcs.name: Tom Tinkervane
npcs.description: Tom Tinkervane is a brilliant, sleep-starved Gnome inventor whose paranoia is often wrong in detail and terrifyingly correct in pattern. He builds signal jammers, disguise linings, coded kites, false-bottom lanterns, and ichor-detection gadgets for the Freeblade Veil while insisting every wall, pigeon, and teapot may be listening. Under the spirals of conspiracy is a loyal mind trying to keep vulnerable people ahead of hunters who really are hunting them.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Sylthéa is a Village in Sylvavéryn, under Theocracy, with low danger, Partial forest, Farming, Marshes and swamps terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Gnome reads through the Deep Gnome entry of the race compendium, within Dwarven and Gnomish Kin, marked by Marduthor. Deep gnomes, or svirfneblin, are adapted to life in the deep subterranean world. They are cautious, stealthy, and highly resourceful in dangerous underground environments. Table cues: Gnome, Darkvision, Gift of the Svirfneblin, Gnomish Magic Resistance; starting tendency Neutral - Lawful - Neutral - Honorable.
rumors: Tom claims the city rain repeats Directorate codes if it hits brass gutters at the right angle.
One of Tom's ridiculous ichor alarms once saved an entire safehouse.
plotHooks: Tom needs the party to test a new route-marker device before it accidentally guides fugitives into a patrol.
A machine everyone dismissed as one of Tom's delusions starts predicting real disappearances.
